Elara Dawn - Album 8.5: Elara Dawn

The Fate Time Decided

"The fate Time decided"

[Intro — the battlefield, everything closing in] She has nowhere left to go The field behind her The field in front of her Everything coming at once Everything at once

And then

A sound that is not a sound A silence that snaps

[Verse 1 — from the battlefield to the cosmos] One moment: smoke and iron Everything that wants her gone Every force that found a reason Every tide she stood against

And then

A field

Not this field

A field that has no war in it A field that has no edge Where the sky is not a sky but something older that does not have a name in any language she has spoken

And she is standing in it And she is not alone

[Pre-Chorus] He does not speak first

He does not speak at all for a long time

He is the one who watches from a place that watching cannot reach The one who made the rule that says: I do not intervene

Standing in front of her Having intervened

[Chorus] The fate Time decided Was not the one the battlefield was writing The fate Time decided Was this

This field This quiet This proximity The closest the daughters have ever been without knowing it yet

The fate Time decided: she would not fall today Not today Not here Not before she knows

[Verse 2 — the touch] He crosses to her

He does not say: I am sorry it took this long He does not say: You should not have had to carry this alone

He says nothing

He raises his hand

He places it very gently on her head

And the knowing begins

[Pre-Chorus 2] Not like a flood Not like a wound

Like a door opening from the inside

Like remembering something you never forgot but had no language for until now

[Chorus] The fate Time decided Was that she would see it all The fate Time decided Was: enough

Enough of not knowing Enough of half the picture Enough of walking toward something without understanding the full shape of what she walks toward

The fate Time decided Was Illuminate

[Bridge — what she sees when the knowing lands] She sees Pandora

Not the wicked Not the corrupted Not the fifth rider Not the gaze

Pandora Raven Daughter of Time and Fate Standing in a tower Having arrived

She sees the castle in the south The five who stayed The priest who went silent Olan sent away in the moment before everything fell

She sees the book Changing hands across 300,000 years

She sees the fracture She sees who made it And why And what survived it

She sees what she is walking toward Not an enemy A sister

She sees everything

And he takes his hand away

And she is still standing

[Final Chorus] The fate Time decided Was that she would be ready The fate Time decided Was that she would know her name Not the Crimson Not the Lawbringer Not the one who marched

Elara Dawn Daughter of Time and Fate

The fate Time decided Was that she would arrive

[Outro — the cosmic field, a moment before it ends] He does not say goodbye He does not explain He just steps back The way something returns to not intervening

And she stands in the quiet field With everything she now knows

And somewhere across the same quiet She can almost feel A tower And a light That is not hers But familiar In the way that home feels familiar before you have arrived

She is not there yet

But she knows the way now
